description: The optional embedded VS Code used by the project editors. This card manages the install; running instances appear under Performance → Managed Processes.
downloadCancelled: Download cancelled. The partial archive was removed.
title: Pro IDE (code-server)
uninstallConfirmBody: This stops every running instance and deletes the install along with its editor state (settings, extensions, open editors). The next switch to Pro IDE downloads it again.
unsupported: code-server publishes no build for this platform, so Pro IDE is unavailable here.
